tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Check a civil date in the general, banking, or judicial calendar for a supported Argentine jurisdiction.

tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: List holidays and non-working days for a year and jurisdiction, including inherited national holidays and official citations.

tools.name: next_business_day
tools.description: Find the first business day strictly after a civil date in the selected Argentine calendar.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Move forward or backward by business days. Zero returns the starting date even if it is not a business day.

tools.name: judicial_deadline
tools.description: Count judicial business days after notification and return the deadline, grace period, and documented court scope. The AR scope covers the national calendar; individual federal courts may have their own recesses.

tools.name: get_index
tools.description: Read CER, UVA, UVI, or a national or regional IPC for one date, one month, or an inclusive range. Values stay decimal strings. ICL returns unsupported_index.

tools.name: adjust_amount_by_index
tools.description: Adjust a positive decimal amount between two dates or months by CER, UVA, UVI, or an IPC. The result is a decimal string rounded half up to cents. ICL returns unsupported_index.
